d: This is not art and I am not an artist. AI is nothing more than unholy amalgam of all other existing work. That being said I started generating pictures on my own PC and realized I was making a somewhat of story. I realized i could finish it off and upload it. Like I said THIS IS NOT ART. Its something I wanted to see and I have not the time to learn to draw or the money to pay for something this long or detailed. If you see something you believe to be "traced" by the AI please let me know and I'll be happy to either add credit to the page or delete the page entirely. This turned out to be much more work than expected even with AI party because I have no idea what I'm doing and partly because I generated almost 10,000 pictures of which about 1% ended up here and because I needed to "storyboard" I guess would be the right word. I'll be in about 40 hours by the time everything is uploaded.
